title: Cover Studio: surface swallowed generation errors (bulk poller had no catch; non-JSON responses became SyntaxError)

comments.author: yuri
comments.text:
Root cause (reproduced locally on :3901): 1) runBulk status-poller fetch('/bulk/status/:id').then(r.json()) had NO catch — a non-JSON poll response (404 'no job' after admin restart, proxy 502 HTML) threw inside setInterval forever: progress froze at 'starting…', Generate stayed disabled = 'nothing happens'. 2) POST response r.json() turned text errors (503 'openrouter not configured') into cryptic SyntaxError. 3) Completion showed only an error COUNT, never messages. 4) Server silently skipped ids not in catalog. 5) OpenRouter fetch had no timeout — a hung request stuck the job at 0/N.

Fix: views.tsx readJson() helper (text-first, throws 'HTTP <status> — <body>' on non-JSON); poller rejection handler clears interval + restores buttons + shows 'failed: <msg>'; completion alerts full error messages; unknown-id → 'game not in catalog' error entry; generate.ts MODEL_TIMEOUT_MS=180s via AbortSignal.timeout.

Verified: bun test 12 pass (new regression test 'bulk progress surfaces failures instead of swallowing them'); served JS node --check OK; curl-driven job on dummy key: {done:1, errors:['Hot Streak/front: openrouter image 401: Missing Authentication header']} surfaced by poller; browser flow: click → 'starting…' → done+reload, buttons never stuck. NOTE live latency: ~17s+ per face cold (composePrompt palette + OpenRouter) — slow, not broken.
